name: skills
description: A curated collection of 32+ Agent Skills for Claude Code covering development workflows, content generation, research, design, and skill creation. Based on the OpenSkills standard.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Core development workflow skills: planning, TDD, debugging, code review, branch management, and parallel agent dispatching. Based on obra/superpowers.

plugins.name: content-generation
plugins.description: Generate images, videos, podcasts, presentations, and data charts from text descriptions.

plugins.name: research-analysis
plugins.description: Deep web research, GitHub repository analysis, data analysis with DuckDB, and consulting-grade report generation.

plugins.name: design-deploy
plugins.description: Production-grade frontend design, web design compliance auditing, and Vercel deployment.

plugins.name: skill-development
plugins.description: Create, write, discover, evaluate, and optimize Agent Skills. Includes skill-creator with eval tooling, bootstrap for AI partner onboarding, find-skills for marketplace discovery, and skill-optimizer for performance improvements.

plugins.name: extras
plugins.description: Brainstorming for pre-implementation design and creative surprise experiences.

plugins.name: mac-setup
plugins.description: Configure a new Mac development environment from scratch. Covers Homebrew, Git, Zsh/Oh My Zsh, iTerm2, tmux, vim, ssh, and modern CLI tools.

plugins.name: claude-code-security-config
plugins.description: Configure Claude Code security to prevent sensitive file leaks and workspace pollution. Sets up deny rules for credentials, .claudeignore, sandbox mode, security instructions in CLAUDE.md, and auto-cleanup hooks.
